impl.summary: Pika H3 Flex now runs on the open engine. There are four 6-step graphs on Pika's Comfy adapters, and all four pass validation on the live CPU ComfyUI. MiniMax H3 gets a Quality choice 'Fast · Pika Flex (6 steps)' next to Standard (8 steps) and Sharper (20 steps). The Video studio gets a References mode: up to 9 images, 3 clips and 3 voice or music clips, checked against Pika's limits before anything uploads, shown in order as 'Image 1 … Clip 1, Voice 1', which the server turns into H3's <Picture N>/<Video N>/<Audio N> tags. Cinema takes on your GPU send @Elements, several images and reference clips to Ref2VA. Lipsync & avatars gets 'Talk from a voice clip'. Settings → Models & licences lists both adapters with Pika's NOTICE, switched on. /connect gets a 'Video from references' row. There is no cloud route: no cloud service offers Pika H3 Flex, and the UI says so.
built: Graphs minimax-h3-flex-t2v / -i2v / -flf2v (FL2VA) and minimax-h3-flex-ref2va (core MiniMaxH3ReferenceToVideo). They are hand-built in scripts/comfy/hand-built, follow Comfy-Org's video_pika_h3_flex_* templates, and have library.spec.mjs entries. Sampling: LoraLoaderModelOnly at 1.0, KSamplerSelect lcm, ManualSigmas 1.0, 0.972973, 0.923077, 0.8, 0.571429, 0.333333, 0 (the 1000/750/500/250/100/40/0 knots at video shift 12), BasicGuider at CFG 1, no SigmaShift node and no Turbo LoRA. All four built and validated (validated: true). Two expanded ref2va variants (2 images + clip + voice, and clip only) were also POSTed to the live ComfyUI with 0 node_errors.

Pika's files pinned at 3ff166447d5e in workflows/comfyui/model-pins.json: pika_h3_flex_fl2va_comfy_bf16 (1956172176 B, sha 68783e64…) and pika_h3_flex_ref2va_comfy_bf16 (1956172176 B, sha e4d058fb…). requirements.json was rebuilt. The adapters are downloaded at run time (pikaFlexGraphLoras in src/lib/catalog/pika-flex.ts, wired into graphLoras in generations.ts), never committed.

src/lib/h3-references.ts (pure): H3_REFERENCE_LIMITS, h3ReferenceProblem (needs an image or clip; 9/3/3, 12 in all; each clip 2-15 s; each group ≤ 15 s; a clip's own sound isn't counted as a file), h3ReferenceLabels, h3ReferenceTags, h3TalkPrompt, openReferenceMode, and expandH3References. The expander adds loaders in order: LoadImage → ref_images.ref_image_N; VHS_LoadVideo at 24 fps capped at 360 frames → ref_videos, plus the clip's own sound → ref_video_audios when the header says it has sound; LoadAudio → ref_audios. Image 1's loader is removed when there is no image.
comfy-variants: H3_FLEX_GRAPH (quality 'flex' → the Flex graphs; an orbit still wins). Manifest expand type gains 'references'.

ComfyUI provider: on the references graph, Pika's limits are checked on the uploads' headers before the run. Aspect ratio is kept for references (not frames). Avatar on H3 = one image + the voice as audio reference, with frames set to h3Frames(voice length clamped to 5-15 s). generations.ts wraps ref2v prompts (names → tags) and avatar prompts (h3TalkPrompt) in H3's layout.

Catalog oss-minimax-h3: ref2v and avatar routes on minimax-h3-flex-ref2va; maxImages 9, maxVideos 3, maxAudios 3; Quality values fast/best/flex relabelled 'Standard · 8 steps' / 'Sharper · 20 steps, about 2.3x longer' / 'Fast · Pika Flex (6 steps)'. engineNote says Flex runs on your GPU only and the cloud runs hosted MiniMax H3 without it. takesClips accepts ComfyUI routes whose model declares maxVideos/maxAudios.

Cinema (planVideo): on your GPU, a model with a references mode takes several images or @Elements and clips as ref2v. Images give way to clips so the total stays at 12. Other open models keep one start frame.

Video studio UI: a 'References' chip (icon-only on phones) opens Add clip / Add voice tiles (new src/components/studio/reference-tray.tsx). Tiles are named Clip N / Voice N. An order line reads 'References in order: …' and shows Pika-limit problems; these block Generate through planError. Clip lengths are read in the browser. New Draft fields refClips/refAudios; upload reaper and replaceAttachment handle them; buildRequest sends inputs.videos/audios only for a studio with ref2v.

Licences: PIKA_FLEX_LORAS rows (MiniMax H3 Community License, regions class, Pika's NOTICE with the Mellis, Inc. copyright among the notices, model card URL), switched on; knownSwitch knows them. Manifest licence text adds the adapters and the NOTICE requirement.

GPU pre-flight: new STUDIO_ROWS row '/video?model=oss-minimax-h3' ('Video from references': the Ref2VA graph plus Pika's Ref2VA adapter). The Video row skips ref2v (new skipOps) so it doesn't ask for the Ref2VA partition. modelTool includes the graph's own adapter.

Cloud check at primary sources: the fal OpenAPI schemas for minimax/h3/image-to-video/lora and minimax/h3/reference-to-video/lora take loras[{path, scale, weight_name}] but have no steps / scheduler / sigmas field, so fal runs its own schedule. fal model search for 'pika' returned 0 models. replicate.com/pika-labs/pika-h3-flex returns 404. Pika's hosted extras (4K, stems, prompt rewriter) are only on Pika's own API. So there is no cloud route, and the cloud keeps hosted minimax-h3 under its own name.
impl.tests: New tests/pika-flex.test.ts: 16 tests covering the graphs' contract and pins, variant choice, adapter downloads, reference limits / labels / tags, the expander, provider binding and refusals, Video-studio planning, Cinema mapping, Lipsync 'Talk from a voice clip' (158 frames for a 6 s voice), licence rows and pre-flight rows. All pass. Updated tests/open-minimax-h3, cinema-refs (on your GPU the note now names MiniMax H3 as the model that takes clips), and model-access-listings (183 LoRAs). Targeted runs passed: 28 files / 662 tests, then 27 files / 438 tests, then 4 files / 90 tests after the last UI change. This covered comfy-library-4/7/notes, comfy-provider, gpu-requirements, cinema*, elements, model-access*, public-signup*, hosted-runs, composer* and others. tsc and eslint are clean. No full Vitest was run. Browser check: new tests/e2e/pika-flex.mjs in demo mode at 1440 and 390, light and dark, all passed with no console errors and no sideways scroll. It covers the References tray, Clip 1 / Voice 1 order line, Free price (desktop), the 17 s voice refused, the Quality menu listing Fast · Pika Flex, no tray on the cloud H3, Cinema, and Lipsync with MiniMax H3. Dev server stopped and .next deleted. Nothing was rendered on a GPU: Pika's quality and speed claims are Pika's own, and Pika says no end-to-end ComfyUI render was verified.
left: No GPU render of any Flex graph. VRAM is recorded as 32 GB (Pika published only H100 80 GB).
The expander loads clips with VideoHelperSuite's VHS_LoadVideo at run time, so requirements.json doesn't list VHS for minimax-h3-flex-ref2va. VHS is in the standard install.

The Quality chip still shows on H3's avatar and ref2v runs, where it has no effect: those always run Flex.
Fuobe Speak and Genjutsu Motion were not given explicit H3 Flex options beyond what the catalog's avatar route makes available. Assist untouched.

docsNotes: FEATURES / STATUS: MiniMax H3 on your GPU has Quality 'Fast · Pika Flex (6 steps)' (Pika H3 Flex), a References mode in the Video studio (9 images, 3 clips, 3 voice or music clips, 12 in all, named Image 1 / Clip 1 / Voice 1 in the prompt), Cinema references on your GPU, and 'Talk from a voice clip' in Lipsync & avatars. All open-engine only: no cloud service hosts Pika H3 Flex, and fal's MiniMax H3 LoRA routes run their own step count.

ARCHITECTURE: src/lib/h3-references.ts (limits, tags, expander; manifest expand 'references'), src/lib/catalog/pika-flex.ts (adapters, NOTICE, graph LoRAs), H3_FLEX_GRAPH in comfy-variants, the reference-tray component, and STUDIO_ROWS skipOps plus the 'Video from references' row.

findings.summary: Lipsync & avatars with MiniMax H3: a Video + Voice request plans to text-to-video, so the person's clip and voice are dropped without a word.
findings.detail: oss-minimax-h3 now has an 'avatar' route, so it shows in Lipsync & avatars, where the Video slot still shows and satisfies anyOf [image, video]. inferOperation (src/lib/catalog/plan.ts:36-50) returns 'lipsync' only when the model has a lipsync route, and 'avatar' only with an image. Every other branch misses, so it falls through to has('t2v'). Probe through planGeneration: {feature:'lipsync', modelId:'oss-minimax-h3', prompt:'friendly', inputs:{video, audio}} → op t2v, endpoint minimax-h3-t2v. With no words it answers 'Write a prompt first'. Neither the composer (studioOp is undefined for a 2-op studio) nor the server checks that the op is one of the studio's ops. This is new: every other avatar-only model has no t2v route to fall back to. Fix: on H3 in this studio, need the Portrait (hide or refuse the Video slot), or refuse a 'lipsync' request on a model with no lipsync route instead of falling through to t2v.

findings.summary: Video studio on H3: with an End frame set, the reference clips, voice clips and extra images are silently dropped (it runs flf2v), while the order line says they go.
findings.detail: inferOperation checks images + endImage → flf2v (plan.ts:44) before ref2v. Probe: {images:[a], endImage:b, videos:[c]} on oss-minimax-h3 → flf2v / minimax-h3-flf2v. buildRequest still sends inputs.videos/audios, and refProblem / ReferenceOrder still show 'References in order: Image 1, Clip 1, Voice 1'. The flf2v graph binds only image/endImage, so the clips, voices and refs[1..] never reach the run. Fix: block it in planError (references can't be combined with an end frame), or hide the End frame while References is open.

findings.summary: Switching off a Pika H3 Flex adapter in Settings → Models & licences does nothing: Flex, References and Talk runs still download and load it.
findings.detail: PIKA_FLEX_LORAS rows have a switch (knownSwitch accepts them). But offeredLoras is only called on plan.loras (generations.ts:734) and on explicit graph-LoRA checks: regenSwitchedOff, swap-studio.ts:851/853, genjutsu.ts:263/268, remove-object.ts:174. pikaFlexGraphLoras feeds graphLoras → ensureLorasOnComfy (generations.ts:1809) with no access check. Every other graph-loaded LoRA refuses with 'switched off in Settings → Models & licences'. The owner's rule says the admin turns things on or off. Fix: refuse (or route Quality flex back to Standard) when offeredLoras([PIKA_FLEX_FL2VA|REF2VA]).dropped is non-empty, with a test.

findings.summary: The References tray's 'Add clip' and 'Add voice' tiles have a 'Choose from library' button that does nothing.
findings.detail: MediaSlot renders <LibraryPicker onPick={onChange}/> on every empty tile (media-slot.tsx:322). ReferenceTiles passes onChange={() => {}} for both tiles (lines 346 and 350), so picking a clip or voice from the library closes the popover and adds nothing. The button is keyboard-focusable (focus-visible:opacity-100). Fix: wire onChange to append the picked SlotValue to refClips/refAudios with the same max.

findings.summary: A References run with a clip needs VideoHelperSuite, which requirements.json and the GPU pre-flight don't list, so the board can say Ready while the run fails at queue time.
findings.detail: expandH3References adds VHS_LoadVideo per clip. requirements.json 'minimax-h3-flex-ref2va' lists packs:{} (the implementer noted it). An account's own ComfyUI without VHS gets Ready on 'Video from references' and an unknown-node error on its first clip run. The installed core LoadVideo + GetVideoComponents (used by other H3 graphs here) would avoid the pack, or VHS could go in the row's optional pack.

review.verdict: changes-requested: the graphs, pins, licence data, cloud decision and reference limits are right and verified at primary sources, but three flows fail without a word: Lipsync on H3 with a Video runs text-to-video, End frame + references runs flf2v without the references, and the Pika adapters' Settings switch doesn't stop runs. The dead library picker in the tray should be fixed too. All are small, local fixes; the rest of the findings are low.

applied: F1 (medium-high, confirmed): planGeneration (src/lib/catalog/plan.ts) now refuses a request where the operation was inferred and it drops an attached video, which happens when a video lands on t2v/i2v/flf2v/keyframes/ref2v/avatar (MAKES_FROM_STILLS). On a model with an avatar route and no lipsync route (MiniMax H3, InfiniteTalk) the message is: '<model> makes a new talking video from a portrait and the voice; it doesn't re-sync an existing clip. Add a portrait instead of the video, or pick another model'. Lipsync & avatars shows it as the blocker. Models that have a lipsync route (LatentSync) still re-sync.

F2 (medium, confirmed): the planner refuses flf2v when reference clips or sound are attached. The composer also blocks References mode when an end frame sits next to extra images, clips or sound: 'References can't go with an end frame. Remove the end frame, or the references'. This blocker comes before 'Write a prompt first'; WRITE_PROMPT is now exported from src/lib/composer.ts.

F3 (medium, confirmed): in src/server/generations.ts, a ComfyUI route whose graph loads a Pika adapter (pikaFlexGraphLoras) now checks offeredLoras. If the adapter is switched off, the run is refused. The owner sees '<Fast · Pika Flex | References | Talk from a voice clip> runs with “<adapter>”, which is switched off in Settings → Models & licences. Pick Standard or Sharper / Use one start frame, or pick another model, or turn it back on there'. An account sees '<mode> isn't available here. …', with no LoRA, Settings or file wording.

F4 (low-medium, confirmed): the References tray's 'Choose from library' now adds the picked clip or voice. New attach.addToList (attachments.ts) applies the same max and toast, and ReferenceTiles gets an onPick prop.

F5 (low, confirmed): new spec field runtimeNodes, for classes the app adds per run. build-library.mjs counts them for customNodes and writes them to the manifest entry. build-requirements.mjs counts them as the graph's classes. ManifestWorkflow type gains runtimeNodes. minimax-h3-flex-ref2va declares runtimeNodes ['VHS_LoadVideo'], so requirements.json now lists packs {ComfyUI-VideoHelperSuite: [VHS_LoadVideo]} and the GPU pre-flight asks for VideoHelperSuite. Only that entry was rebuilt (build-library.mjs minimax-h3-flex-ref2va, then build-requirements.mjs). The graph file is unchanged, so it stays validated: true.

F6 (low, partly): the Quality control on oss-minimax-h3 gains ops (t2v/i2v/flf2v for all three values), so the chip is hidden on References and Talk runs, which always use Flex. CREDITS.md: a Pika H3 Flex attribution (Mellis, Inc., MiniMax H3 Community License, NOTICE note) is added to ATTRIBUTIONS in src/lib/licences.ts, and that one line, exactly as scripts/credits.mjs writes it, is added to CREDITS.md.

F7 (low, confirmed): tests/e2e/pika-flex.mjs waits for the order line, the price and the refusals (waitText polls the body and the Generate button's label) instead of reading them at once. It also checks two new flows at all four sizes: the end frame plus clip refusal, and Lipsync Video + Voice on H3 being refused. Before the Quality check it removes the clip, since Quality is now hidden on references.

Tests: tests/pika-flex.test.ts has 5 new tests: Lipsync re-sync refusal (and LatentSync still lipsyncs), end frame + clips/sound refusal, Quality chip ops, the Settings switch through previewGeneration for owner and account, and the VHS pack in requirements. Updated tests: open-minimax-h3 (control ops), open-engine (a control offered on some ops only is checked against those routes only), gpu-requirements (runtimeNodes count as graph classes).
rejected: F6 remainder: no H3 Flex option was added to Fuobe Speak or Genjutsu Motion, and Assist is untouched. Each is a separate studio change with its own planner and tests, and both reach H3 through the catalog's avatar/ref2v routes already. Left for a later package.

fix.finalSummary: Pika H3 Flex on MiniMax H3 is complete on the open engine. The four 6-step graphs are pinned and validated on the CPU ComfyUI. Quality offers 'Fast · Pika Flex (6 steps)' on words and frames. The References mode takes 9 images, 3 clips and 3 voice or music clips, with Pika's limits checked before upload and the names Image N, Clip N and Voice N turned into H3's tags. Cinema references and 'Talk from a voice clip' also work. The review's silent drops now produce plain refusals: a clip given to re-sync on H3, and an end frame beside references. The Settings → Models & licences switch for each adapter now stops the runs that load it. The library picker in the tray works. The GPU pre-flight asks for VideoHelperSuite for references. Open engine: everything above is built, unit- and browser-tested in demo mode, and the graphs are validated (POSTed with 0 node_errors). No GPU render has been done, so speed, quality and VRAM (recorded as 32 GB) are Pika's claims, and Pika itself did not verify an end-to-end ComfyUI render. Cloud engine: there is no Pika H3 Flex route. fal's MiniMax H3 LoRA endpoints take adapters but expose no steps, scheduler or sigmas, and Pika is not on fal or Replicate. The cloud keeps hosted MiniMax H3 under its own name, and the UI says Flex runs on your GPU only. No key is needed for the open engine. Under public sign-up: guests browse read-only. Accounts run Flex, References and Talk only on their own ComfyUI, with inputs going through the existing account checks (prep, prepClip, prepVoice in account-inputs). Accounts get plain-words refusals with no LoRA or Settings wording. The adapter switches stay the owner's. No new API routes were added.
